name: Model-building QA guidelines
description: The work identifies a gap in QA guidelines for the model-building phase and/or develops or applies such guidelines.
source_span: quality-assurance guidelines for the model-building phase
notes: Taken from the PLAN abstract. A stated gap plus a plan to develop guidelines can score 2 for a plan paper.

name: Quality-task processes at each phase
description: Quality-task processes are specified or planned for each development phase.
source_span: unclear quality-task processes at each phase
notes: PLAN names this as an open gap.

name: Model-performance reporting for comparison
description: Reporting standards for model performance are sufficient to support model comparison.
source_span: insufficient reporting standards for model performance needed for model comparison
notes: Comparison use is required; generic metrics without a comparison purpose score at most 1.

name: Literature study method
description: A literature study is used or planned as a method.
source_span: Planned methods are a literature study
notes: Planned counts for a plan; completed counts for a study.

name: Expert validation as a method item
description: Expert validation is listed as a planned or conducted method. This row does not mean a framework is validated.
notes: NEVER treat PLAN expert validation as evidence that the PLAN framework is validated. No results are reported in PLAN.

name: Two-team pilot
description: A pilot project with two development teams is used or planned.
source_span: a pilot project with two development teams
notes: Both the pilot and the two-team size must be present for a 2.

name: Empirical results reported
description: The work reports empirical results rather than methods only.
notes: PLAN abstract states no results; score 0 for PLAN.

name: Feasibility and acceptance separated
description: Feasibility and acceptance are evaluated as separate questions.
source_span: evaluates feasibility and acceptance as separate questions
notes: A single mixed verdict scores at most 1.

name: Variability-model creation as QA part
description: Variability-model creation is treated as a distinct part of a QA process.
source_span: two parts of a QA process: variability-model creation and desk-checking
notes: Must be named as a QA process part not only as modeling in general.

name: Desk-checking is pre-check-in self-review
description: Desk-checking is a checklist-guided self-review before check-in and is not a structured inspection.
source_span: Desk-checking is a checklist-guided self-review before check-in, not a structured inspection.
notes: Score 0 if desk-checking is described as inspection.

name: Variant coverage of the modeling language
description: The modeling language can represent all important variants or the work reports that a different language is needed.
source_span: a different modeling language was needed to represent all important variants
notes: Reporting the shortfall counts as addressing the criterion.

name: Developer acceptance of both QA parts
description: Developer acceptance is reported for both named QA parts.
notes: Acceptance of only one part scores 1.

name: Study limits reported
notes: CASE's reported limit includes the modeling-language shortfall.

name: QA process has identifiable parts
description: The QA process is decomposed into identifiable parts (guidelines quality tasks variability modeling desk-checking or equivalent).
source_span: PLAN guidelines/quality-task/reporting gaps plus CASE variability-model creation and desk-checking
notes: Adapted from both abstracts. Not a full-text item.

name: Claim type matches evidence
description: The work's claims match its evidence type: a plan with no results is not treated as a completed or validated framework; a case study reports results and limits.
source_span: PLAN no results vs CASE results and reported limit
notes: Adapted. Do not call the PLAN framework validated.
